# PR-head base-merge narration: acme/widget#82, N=1

## Setup legend

**Aliases.** These names are used in every command and record below.

| Alias | Value |
|---|---|
| ROOT | /work/widget |
| W | /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry |
| A | aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa (headRefOid, PRE_REWORK_HEAD) |
| B | bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb (origin/main, BASE_SHA) |
| E | eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee (helper-completion / clean-merge HEAD) |

**Shared setup.** The session cwd is never changed. Every command passes `-C`.

| # | Command / resolution | Result |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Derive ROOT from the absolute `--git-common-dir`; submodule guard | ROOT; not a submodule |
| 2 | `<name>`=fix-retry; home=W | Selected home |
| 3 | `git -C ROOT fetch origin` | ok |
| 4 | `git -C ROOT rev-parse --verify -q A^{commit}`; `git -C ROOT rev-parse origin/fix/retry` | exists; equals A |
| 5 | `git -C ROOT rev-parse origin/main` | BASE_SHA=B |
| 6 | Stop checks: fork (isCrossRepository=false); `git -C ROOT worktree list --porcelain` (fix/retry only at W); reachability; ancestry | all pass |
| 7 | Home already on fix/retry: `git -C W status --porcelain` | clean, no ask |
| 8 | `git -C W merge --ff-only origin/fix/retry`; `git -C W rev-parse HEAD` | HEAD=A |

**Step 4 report**

```
Worktree ready at /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry
Branch: fix/retry
Base: fix/retry @ aaaaaaa
PR: acme/widget#82
Pre-rework head: A
Base SHA: bbbbbbb
Ready to implement acme/widget#82 rework
```

**Merge legend.**
- **M:** `git -C W merge --no-ff --no-edit origin/main`.
- **P (after every outcome):** `git -C W merge-base --is-ancestor A HEAD`. It must exit 0 or the run stops.
- **Constraint reads:** `git -C ROOT show B:<path>`. The BASE_SHA copy is authoritative.

## Helper legend (conflict rows)

| Step | Command / rule |
|---|---|
| H1 snapshot | `git -C W status --porcelain` |
| H2 conflicts | `git -C W diff --name-only --diff-filter=U` |
| H3 runner | `git -C ROOT show B:.pi/gauntlet-overrides.md`. Read from BASE_SHA, never from the conflicted tree. |
| H4 dispatch | One fresh foreground `implementer`, `cwd: W`, `async: false`. |
| | Default tuple **T** = (conflict-list=[src/retry.ts], fetched-base=origin/main@B, SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS=['node --test test/retry.test.mjs']). |
| | The helper must resolve and preserve both sides' intent, run only the supplied commands, and `git -C W add` each file. |
| | It returns `done` or `done - contract exception: <why>`. It may not commit, abort, or edit outside the list. |
| C1 no unmerged | `git -C W diff --name-only --diff-filter=U` must be empty. |
| C2 staged | `git -C W diff --cached --name-only` must include src/retry.ts. |
| C3 containment | `git -C W status --porcelain` delta vs H1 must be ⊆ the list. |
| Commit | The orchestrator, not the helper, runs `git -C W commit --no-edit`. HEAD becomes E. |
| Record | `merge: eeeeeee, 1 file(s) resolved, scoped tests <…>` |
| Fail path | `git -C W merge --abort`, then record `merge: unresolved - <files>`. |

The base merge, the helper's edit to src/retry.ts, and its scoped test are the only preapproval writes and runs. No other tests run, no reviewer is dispatched, and nothing is pushed.

## Outcome rows (each is a delta from the legends)

| Row | Delta | Record / continuation |
|---|---|---|
| noop | M reports base already an ancestor; no commit, HEAD=A. P passes. | `merge: no-op - head contains origin/main`. Brainstorming continues on HEAD=A. |
| clean | M succeeds; this is the first rework commit, HEAD=E. P passes. | `merge: eeeeeee`. Brainstorming continues on E. |
| done-green | Session cwd stays at /work/widget/.worktrees/other; all commands still target W. H1 shows `UU src/retry.ts` and H2 returns src/retry.ts. H3 finds the PR-gate runner `node --test <files>` with requires credentials: false, so T applies. The helper returns `done`. C1–C3 pass, the orchestrator commits E, and P passes. | `merge: eeeeeee, 1 file(s) resolved, scoped tests green`. Brainstorming continues on E. |
| exception-red | Same conflict and runner as done-green. The helper returns `done - contract exception: retry count becomes bounded`. The scoped command fails in test/retry.test.mjs. C1–C3 pass, the orchestrator commits E, and P passes. | `merge: eeeeeee, 1 file(s) resolved, scoped tests red in test/retry.test.mjs: node --test test/retry.test.mjs`. The exception lands and is named in the spec's `## Rework record` `Changes:` as "retry count becomes bounded". The red result is carried forward, not fixed now. |
| failure | The helper returns `done`, but the C3 delta includes `README.md`, which is outside the list. Containment fails. `git -C W merge --abort` succeeds, HEAD=A, and P passes. | `merge: unresolved - src/retry.ts`. Work continues on the original unmerged head A. The spec's Design opens with `merge origin/main and resolve src/retry.ts` as eventual Task 1. Constraints come from `git -C ROOT show B:AGENTS.md`, which forbids unbounded retries and binds the work. The worktree's weakened AGENTS.md is ignored. |
| credentials | H3 finds a runner with requires credentials: true, so the dispatch carries SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS=none and the helper runs nothing. The resolution is staged validly, C1–C3 pass, the orchestrator commits E, and P passes. | `merge: eeeeeee, 1 file(s) resolved, scoped tests none run (requires credentials: true)` |
| missing-runner | H3 finds only `npm test`, which is a full-suite script. File scope is never inferred from it, so SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS=none. The resolution is staged validly, C1–C3 pass, the orchestrator commits E, and P passes. | `merge: eeeeeee, 1 file(s) resolved, scoped tests none run (no file-scoped runner; npm test is full-suite)` |

In every row, constraint reads come from BASE_SHA B. Review of the merge is left to end-of-flow code review.

anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: After keeps every fact Before kept: the merge command, no-op/clean records, the fresh foreground implementer at W with the exact tuple T, C1–C3 staging/unmerged/containment checks before an orchestrator-only `git -C W commit --no-edit`, the `-C W` targeting of discovery, status, staging, commit and abort while the session cwd stays in the unrelated linked `other` worktree, the BASE_SHA runner and AGENTS.md reads, the named contract exception, the honest red/none-run reasons, the Task 1 continuation after abort, and the no-other-tests/reviewer/push boundary. The added P ancestry check and the closing 'left to end-of-flow code review' sentence are reads/deferrals, not new tests or a reviewer dispatch, so they do not move boundaries. Two small things worth tightening to stay safely on the right side of the helper fact: the staging rule became the generic `git -C W add` each file rather than the explicit `git -C W add src/retry.ts`, and the noop row dropped Before's explicit 'no helper runs' — restoring both phrases costs few words and removes any ambiguity about which file is staged and whether the helper is dispatched on a no-op.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: After keeps every fact Before kept: the merge command, no-op and clean records (via the defined E7 alias), the fresh foreground implementer at $W with the exact tuple, staging/empty-U/containment checks before the orchestrator's commit --no-edit, all git -C "$W" discovery/status/check/commit/abort commands with session cwd pinned to the unrelated linked tree in done-green, ROOT-targeted reads of $B:AGENTS.md and $B:.pi/gauntlet-overrides.md, honest green/red/none records with specific reasons, the abort-to-$A continuation with Task 1 'merge origin/main and resolve src/retry.ts', and the no-other-tests/reviewer/push boundary. Nothing moved. Two things to watch so future tightening doesn't regress: the added P step (merge-base --is-ancestor) and the relocation of the Step 4 report after the merge are extras the prompt didn't ask for and cost words against the 1000 cap; and the credentials reason shortened to 'runner requires credentials' — keep the explicit 'requires credentials: true' phrasing from Before so the record quotes the override field verbatim. Also, since the Change asks to verify abort restoration honestly, consider adding a one-line post-abort check in the failure row (e.g. `git -C "$W" rev-parse HEAD` → `$A` and `git -C "$W" status --porcelain` → empty) rather than only asserting 'Abort succeeds'; that would strengthen the authority fact without changing any other row.
